_comment: Goal-2 conditioning schema for CloseBlenderLid skill-conditioned SFT/RL. Maps a stable skill_id + overall task goal + natural-language instruction + structured object/destination/constraints onto the Xiaomi policy's ACTUAL conditioning surface, which is the single `instruction` text slot of client.infer(states, images, instruction) plus (for the learned-embedding arm) a skill embedding added to the DiT.
overall_task_goal: Close the blender by placing its lid securely on top, then release and retreat.
policy_prompt_template:
Left camera: <video>
Right camera: <video>
Wrist camera: <video>

Generate robot actions for the task:
{instruction} /no_cot
prompt_template_note: Verbatim from deploy/client.py _build_messages; {instruction} is the only text conditioning slot. The pretrained 365 checkpoint was trained on FULL-task instructions, so partial-skill prompts are out-of-distribution (see skill model-provenance).

GRASP_HANDLE.instruction_natural_language: Pick up the blender lid securely by its handle.
constraints: do not knock the lid off the counter
achieve a secure grasp before lifting
GRASP_HANDLE.success_predicate: lid_grasped (gripper-lid contact AND lid lifted above rest)

MOVE_LID_TO_CLOSED.instruction_natural_language: Move the grasped blender lid above the blender without colliding with the surroundings.
MOVE_LID_TO_CLOSED.destination: closed position on top of the blender
constraints: reach the pre-place region above the closed pose

RELEASE_HANDLE.instruction_natural_language: Place the grasped blender lid securely on top of the blender, release it, and move the gripper away.
constraints: seat the lid upright (<=7 deg tilt)
RELEASE_HANDLE.success_predicate: lid_on_blender AND gripper_lid_far_0.15 (== official CloseBlenderLid success)

nl_only.description: Arm 1 (Goal 5): instruction = the skill's natural-language string only. No skill_id token, no structured fields. Isolates whether NL alone conditions the policy.

nl_plus_skill_id.description: Arm 2 (Goal 5): instruction = overall goal + a stable skill tag + NL + structured object/destination/constraints, all folded into the single text slot (the only text channel the checkpoint exposes).

shared_lora_learned_embedding.description: Arm 3 (Goal 5): a SINGLE shared LoRA on the DiT plus a learned per-skill embedding (skill_id -> vector) added to the DiT conditioning, with NL instruction held to the overall goal. Tests whether a learned skill code beats text tokens. Do NOT assume it wins; select by heldout.

provenance_caveat: Per-skill LoRA adapters are keyed by skill_id (0/1/2); the ACTIVE adapter is set whenever a skill is supplied (decoupled from eta, per the audited eta/adapter-coupling fix). skill=None forces the pretrained baseline.
